title: The waiting page sorts items newest first inside each tier
why: Owner 21:37 CST Nov 12: "sort the artifact by time so i can quickly answer thr newest ones". The page sorts oldest first inside a tier (sorted() byAge in skills/waiting-page/page.html), so the newest asks sit at the bottom.
source: owner chat with triage 21:37 CST Nov 12; store entry page-newest-first
note: Fix: in skills/waiting-page/page.html sorted(), byAge becomes `age(b) - age(a) || ts(b.added) - ts(a.added) || b.n - a.n`, with a comment citing the ruling; tiers and rank stay. A page test pins the order (red first). Then every repo's page republishes from main. Triage tried a live-only edit at 21:40 CST; guard page-stale refused it (the page must match main), as designed. Departs from: main sorts oldest first inside a tier.
